posts.title: Emergence and the thermodynamic limit
posts.description: One definition of an emergent property is a property of a system of many interacting parts that the parts of the system do not have. A subtle question is how many parts a system must have (i.e., how large it need be) for the system to have an emergent property. posts.description: What criteria do people use to decide if a theory in physics is successful? posts.title: Emergence and centralised planning of scientific research
posts.description: Scientists, individually and collectively, make decisions about research directions and priorities.
